## Results

Upon completion, the process produces:

| Outcome | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| ✅ Business Relationship Agreement | SMA agrees upon relationship with business partner |
| 📡 Communication Protocols | Defined protocols for data exchange |
| 🔔 Partner Notification | Alert sent to notify business partner of agreement |
| 📋 Established Agreement | TPA, SLA, or MOU between business partners |
| 📊 Tracking Information | Data for measuring performance and BAM |
